name: Purr-loined Treasure Flask
description:
When Jahoda switches to become the active character: If the opponent's active character is affected by Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo, convert this card to the corresponding element.
Combat Action: Deal 2 Anemo DMG to the opponent's active character. Then, deal 1 Anemo DMG once again.
